entries.raw: * An appeal court in [[Casablanca]], [[Morocco]], upholds a three year jail term against a human rights activist, [[Chahib Khayari]], for "offending the authorities" after accusing top officials of being involved in drug networks. [http://af.reuters.com/article/topNews/idAFJOE5AN0GW20091124 (Reuters)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20100530220546/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1 (IOL)]
entries.text: An appeal court in Casablanca, Morocco, upholds a three year jail term against a human rights activist, Chahib Khayari, for "offending the authorities" after accusing top officials of being involved in drug networks.

entries.raw: * Two [[France|French]] charity workers are kidnapped in the [[Central African Republic]], in the latest in a series of kidnappings. [https://web.archive.org/web/20091125144051/http://www.iol.co.za/index.php?set_id=1&click_id=68&art_id=nw20091124074021794C588099 (IOL)] [http://en.afrik.com/news13130.html (Afrik.com)]{{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}
entries.text: Two French charity workers are kidnapped in the Central African Republic, in the latest in a series of kidnappings. {{Dead link|date=August 2019 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}

entries.raw: * Four people are killed in a helicopter crash off the coast of [[Netanya]] in northern [[Israel]]. [http://www.jpost.com/servlet/Satellite?cid=1259010967219&pagename=JPost%2FJPArticle%2FShowFull (''Jerusalem Post'')] [http://www.rttnews.com/ArticleView.aspx?Id=1139216&SMap=1 (RTT News)] [https://web.archive.org/web/20091127151655/http://en.trend.az/regions/met/israel/1587448.html (Trend News Agency)]
entries.text: Four people are killed in a helicopter crash off the coast of Netanya in northern Israel.

links.raw: [[November 2009 Great Britain and Ireland floods|recent ongoing flooding]]
links.target: November 2009 Great Britain and Ireland floods

entries.raw: * A nationwide public service strike involving medical staff, teachers and civil servants takes place in areas of [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] not badly affected by [[November 2009 Great Britain and Ireland floods|recent ongoing flooding]]. [http://www.irishtimes.com/newspaper/breaking/2009/1124/breaking10.htm (''The Irish Times'')] [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/europe/8375745.stm (BBC)] [http://www.independent.ie/national-news/striking-workers-head-north-to-shop-1952527.html (''Irish Independent'')]
entries.text: A nationwide public service strike involving medical staff, teachers and civil servants takes place in areas of Ireland not badly affected by recent ongoing flooding.

links.raw: [[November 2009 Great Britain and Ireland floods|ongoing floods]]
links.target: November 2009 Great Britain and Ireland floods

entries.raw: * The [[Government of Ireland]] announces a €10 million humanitarian fund for the worst affected by [[November 2009 Great Britain and Ireland floods|ongoing floods]] in the country. [http://www.rte.ie/news/2009/1124/weather.html (RTÉ)]
entries.text: The Government of Ireland announces a €10 million humanitarian fund for the worst affected by ongoing floods in the country.

entries.raw: * Over 1,500 complaints are received from [[United States|American]] viewers after a [[Homosexuality|gay kiss]] involving [[Adam Lambert]] is televised during an awards ceremony. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/8375994.stm (BBC)]
entries.text: Over 1,500 complaints are received from American viewers after a gay kiss involving Adam Lambert is televised during an awards ceremony.

entries.raw: * [[Iran]] lifts a ban on one of its best-selling newspapers, ''[[Hamshahri]]'', a day after it was banned from publication after publishing a picture of a temple from the [[Baháʼí Faith#Iran|banned]] [[Baháʼí Faith|Baháʼí faith]]. [http://www.presstv.ir/detail.aspx?id=112089&sectionid=351020101 (Press TV)] [https://www.reuters.com/article/mediaNews/idUSGEE5AN2T620091124 (Reuters)]
entries.text: Iran lifts a ban on one of its best-selling newspapers, Hamshahri, a day after it was banned from publication after publishing a picture of a temple from the banned Baháʼí faith.

entries.raw: * The trial of two [[Democratic Republic of the Congo|Congolese]] militia leaders, [[Germain Katanga]] and [[Mathieu Ngudjolo Chui]], begins at the [[International Criminal Court]] in [[The Hague]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/africa/8375601.stm (BBC)] [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/europe/2009/11/20091124142634137365.html (Al Jazeera)] [http://www.google.com/hostednews/ap/article/ALeqM5jIIQpLKyj3NrhJa50Xg3Wte4yxJwD9C60H401 (AP)]
entries.text: The trial of two Congolese militia leaders, Germain Katanga and Mathieu Ngudjolo Chui, begins at the International Criminal Court in The Hague.

entries.raw: * [[Russia]]n [[President of Russia|President]] [[Dmitry Medvedev]] orders an investigation into the death of an anti-corruption lawyer [[Sergei Magnitsky]] who died in prison while awaiting trial on charges of [[tax evasion]]. [http://en.rian.ru/russia/20091124/156968129.html (RIA Novosti)] [https://www.telegraph.co.uk/finance/newsbysector/banksandfinance/6646006/Sergei-Magnitsky-Russia-launches-official-probe-into-lawyers-death.html (''The Daily Telegraph'')]
entries.text: Russian President Dmitry Medvedev orders an investigation into the death of an anti-corruption lawyer Sergei Magnitsky who died in prison while awaiting trial on charges of tax evasion.

entries.raw: * The [[European Parliament]] approves a major overhaul of telecommunications systems in the [[European Union]] aimed at boosting the rights of mobile and internet users. [http://www.google.com/hostednews/afp/article/ALeqM5gtFO00mW0L6De13E0vfo_9W6XRjQ (AFP)] [http://www.euronews.net/2009/11/24/eu-telecoms-reforms-enter-force-in-december/ (euronews)]
entries.text: The European Parliament approves a major overhaul of telecommunications systems in the European Union aimed at boosting the rights of mobile and internet users.

entries.raw: * An [[Chilcot Inquiry|inquiry opens]] in the [[United Kingdom]] over the country's involvement in the [[Iraq War]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/uk_politics/8375439.stm (BBC)] [http://edition.cnn.com/2009/WORLD/europe/11/24/uk.iraq.inquiry/ (CNN)] [http://www.portalangop.co.ao/motix/en_us/noticias/internacional/2009/10/48/inquiry-into-Iraq-war-begins-public-hearings,957098fc-07c9-4045-838c-8898cb0ea02b.html (Angola Press)]
entries.text: An inquiry opens in the United Kingdom over the country's involvement in the Iraq War.

entries.raw: * Pirates kill a [[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] sailor after an oil tanker is attacked off the coast of [[Benin]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/world/africa/8376715.stm (BBC)] [http://www.presstv.ir/detail.aspx?id=112088&sectionid=351020506 (Press TV)]
entries.text: Pirates kill a Ukrainian sailor after an oil tanker is attacked off the coast of Benin.

links.raw: [[2008 Chinese milk scandal|tainted milk poisoning scandal]]

entries.raw: * [[People's Republic of China|China]] executes two people for their role in the [[2008 Chinese milk scandal|tainted milk poisoning scandal]]. [http://news.xinhuanet.com/english/2009-11/24/content_12530798.htm (Xinhua)] [http://www.guardian.co.uk/world/2009/nov/24/china-executes-milk-scandal-pair (''The Guardian'')] [http://english.aljazeera.net/news/asia-pacific/2009/11/2009112474935675377.html (Al Jazeera)]
entries.text: China executes two people for their role in the tainted milk poisoning scandal.

entries.raw: * In a [[Gadhimai festival|tribute to Hindu goddess Gadhimai]], approximately 20,000 buffalo and 300,000 birds, sheep and goats are [[Animal sacrifice|ritually slaughtered]] in a festival in [[Bariyapur]], [[Nepal]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/south_asia/8375591.stm (BBC)] [http://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/world/south-asia/Indians-throng-Nepals-Gadhimai-fair-for-animal-sacrifice/articleshow/5264701.cms (''Times of India'')] [http://edition.cnn.com/2009/WORLD/asiapcf/11/24/nepal.animal.sacrifice/ (CNN)]
entries.text: In a tribute to Hindu goddess Gadhimai, approximately 20,000 buffalo and 300,000 birds, sheep and goats are ritually slaughtered in a festival in Bariyapur, Nepal.

entries.raw: * Philippine President [[Gloria Macapagal Arroyo]] declares a state of emergency in the entire [[Maguindanao]] province in southern [[Philippines]] following the bloodiest election-related [[Maguindanao massacre|massacre]] in Philippine history which left at least 40 people dead, including a local politician and about a dozen journalists. [http://www.abs-cbnnews.com/nation/11/24/09/maguindanao-massacre-toll-rises-39 (ABS-CBN News)]
entries.text: Philippine President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo declares a state of emergency in the entire Maguindanao province in southern Philippines following the bloodiest election-related massacre in Philippine history which left at least 40 people dead, including a local politician and about a dozen journalists.

entries.raw: * [[Northern Mariana Islands gubernatorial election, 2009]]
entries.text: Northern Mariana Islands gubernatorial election, 2009

links.target: Governor of the Northern Mariana Islands
Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives

entries.raw: ** In the [[Northern Mariana Islands]]' first ever [[Two-round system|runoff]], incumbent [[Governor of the Northern Mariana Islands|Governor]] [[Benigno Fitial]] of the [[Covenant Party (Northern Mariana Islands) |Covenant Party]] leads [[Republican Party (Northern Mariana Islands)|Republican Party]] [[Northern Mariana Islands House of Representatives|Rep.]] [[Heinz Hofschneider]]  by 501 votes. [https://web.archive.org/web/20110814224311/http://www.saipantribune.com/newsstory.aspx?cat=1&newsID=95340 (''Saipan Tribune'')]
entries.text: In the Northern Mariana Islands' first ever runoff, incumbent Governor Benigno Fitial of the Covenant Party leads Republican Party Rep. Heinz Hofschneider by 501 votes.

entries.raw: ** An estimated 1,200 [[absentee ballots]] still need to be counted before a winner is declared on December 7, 2009. [https://web.archive.org/web/20110814224311/http://www.saipantribune.com/newsstory.aspx?cat=1&newsID=95340 (''Saipan Tribune'')]
entries.text: An estimated 1,200 absentee ballots still need to be counted before a winner is declared on December 7, 2009.

links.target: Internet censorship in the People's Republic of China

entries.raw: * Web browser [[Opera (web browser)|Opera]] closes a loophole which allowed [[People's Republic of China|Chinese]] users to access websites [[Internet censorship in the People's Republic of China|banned by the government]]. [http://news.bbc.co.uk/1/hi/technology/8376555.stm (BBC)]
entries.text: Web browser Opera closes a loophole which allowed Chinese users to access websites banned by the government.

entries.text: Chilean writer and historian, José Arraño Acevedo dies at the age of 88.
